lessons.title: ਅ — a vowel that can stand first

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Point to the first known piece in ਨਮਸਤੇ: ਨ. A consonant can carry an unwritten a. Today a vowel stands by itself at the beginning of a word.
ਅ (a).
Read it as short a. It is one complete letter, not a mark attached to a consonant. That is why it can begin the practice name in the next lesson.
Keep ਅ visible. Follow one printed model with your finger, then trace it once. Compare only three things: the top line, the upright, and the lower turn.
Cover the model for two seconds. Point to ਅ when it appears beside ਨ.

segments.prompt: Which Gurmukhi letter is the independent short a?

feedback.correct: ਅ can stand at the beginning of a word.
feedback.incorrect: Look once more at ਅ, trace it, and stop.

lessons.title: ਅਮਨ (Aman) — one new piece, two old pieces

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — assemble the practice name until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Read the three separate pieces: ਅ, ਮ, ਨ.
ਅ + ਮ + ਨ becomes ਅਮਨ (Aman).
This book uses ਅਮਨ (Aman) as one closed-bank practice identity. It is not asking you to spell your own name yet.
Keep ਅਮਨ (Aman) visible. Copy it once, saying each piece as your hand reaches it. Compare left to right. Repair only the first differing piece.
Point to the only piece that was new today: ਅ.

segments.prompt: Read the practice name ਅਮਨ (Aman) and type the same Gurmukhi name.

feedback.correct: ਅਮਨ is the first closed-bank practice name.
feedback.incorrect: Rebuild it as ਅ + ਮ + ਨ.

lessons.title: ਮਨਨ (Manan) — two familiar pieces, one repeated

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
waitUntilStopped: Script — assemble the second practice name
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — assemble the second practice name until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write ਮ once and ਨ once. No new letter appears today.

blocks.title: Script — assemble the second practice name

segments.text: ਮ + ਨ + ਨ becomes ਮਨਨ (Manan).
This is the second and final value in the first name-field bank. Notice the two adjacent ਨ letters; neither may disappear.
Keep ਮਨਨ (Manan) visible. Copy it once. Tap three positions after writing: ਮ | ਨ | ਨ. If there are only two positions, restore the final ਨ.
Contrast once: ਅਮਨ (Aman) begins with ਅ; ਮਨਨ (Manan) begins with ਮ.

segments.prompt: Read the practice name ਮਨਨ (Manan) and type the same three-letter Gurmukhi name.

feedback.correct: ਮਨਨ keeps both final ਨ letters.
feedback.incorrect: Tap the three positions: ਮ, ਨ, ਨ.

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — read the label until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Build the known pieces aloud: ਨ + ਾ + ਂ.
ਨਾਂ (nāṁ): __________ (name field).
On a form, ਨਾਂ (nāṁ) asks for a name. The colon belongs to the form; it is not a Gurmukhi letter. Point to the label, then point to the empty answer line.
Copy ਨਾਂ (nāṁ) once. Check the base ਨ, then the long-vowel mark, then the nasal dot. Do not add a name value yet.
Find ਨਾਂ (nāṁ) among ਹਾਂ, ਨਾਂ (nāṁ), ਨਹੀਂ without writing the other two words.

segments.prompt: A form shows ਨਾਂ (nāṁ). What information belongs on that line?

feedback.incorrect: Point to ਨਾਂ and say name once.

lessons.title: Two people, two already-known values
lessons.gloss: select one known name value from a nonverbal identity cue

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
waitUntilStopped: Script — attach one nonverbal cue to each person
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — attach one nonverbal cue to each person until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Read both names. Point to the first differing letter:
ਅਮਨ (Aman), ਮਨਨ (Manan).

blocks.title: Script — attach one nonverbal cue to each person

segments.text: For this closed practice bank only:
A becomes ਅਮਨ (Aman).
B becomes ਮਨਨ (Manan).
Look for five seconds. Cover the Gurmukhi names. Point to A and recall its name; point to B and recall its name. Uncover and compare.
With the bank visible, choose but do not copy: which value belongs to B? Which belongs to A? The skill today is selecting the requested known value.
Stop after the two-way contrast. No third name enters this field bank.

segments.prompt: In this practice bank, select the Gurmukhi name paired with B.

feedback.incorrect: Reveal the two-item bank, point to B becomes ਮਨਨ, then cover it again.

lessons.title: Fill one field with the bank visible
lessons.gloss: complete one name field with a visible two-value bank

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Read the label ਨਾਂ (nāṁ). Recall the visible bank: A ਅਮਨ (Aman), B ਮਨਨ (Manan).
Keep the bank visible. Card A requests its known value:
A — ਨਾਂ (nāṁ): __________ (name field).
Select ਅਮਨ (Aman) and copy it on the line. Read the completed field from label to value. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.
Check only spelling: ਅ | ਮ | ਨ. Do not check spacing or selection in this pass. If one piece differs, repair that one piece.
Stop after one supported field.

segments.prompt: With the two-value bank visible, complete the name field for A.

feedback.incorrect: Use the visible bank, select A becomes ਅਮਨ, and repair only the first differing letter.

lessons.title: Hide the bank, then fill one line
lessons.gloss: complete one requested name field after the answer bank is hidden

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Look once: A ਅਮਨ (Aman), B ਮਨਨ (Manan). Cover the complete bank and wait ten seconds.
Keep the bank hidden. Complete only this field:
B — ਨਾਂ (nāṁ): __________ (name field).
The requested value is chosen from memory; there is no copyable answer beside the line. Reveal the bank only after writing.
Compare in order: (1) selected person, (2) three written positions, (3) any extra space inside the name. Repair the first differing dimension and stop.
This is one delayed choice, not a six-field form.

segments.prompt: After hiding the bank for ten seconds, complete ਨਾਂ (nāṁ) for B. Do not reveal the bank until the attempt is finished.

feedback.correct: The hidden-bank cue selected ਮਨਨ independently.
feedback.incorrect: Reveal the bank now, compare selection then spelling then spacing, and repair one dimension.

lessons.title: One no-model name field
lessons.gloss: choose and write one known name from a nonverbal cue with no model

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Close the previous lesson. Keep only the two learned identity symbols in memory. There is no value bank, support-language name, or romanized answer below.
Complete the requested field:
A — ਨਾਂ (nāṁ): __________ (name field).
Choose the known value attached to A and write it from memory. Do not open an earlier lesson until the attempt is complete.
After writing, compare in four bounded passes: requested person, spelling, spacing, then label/value placement. Repair only the first differing dimension.
You have completed one field pattern. Five more field families remain before the published six-field form can be attempted.

segments.prompt: With no bank, romanization, or copyable answer, complete the name field for A.

feedback.correct: The nonverbal cue independently selected ਅਮਨ.
feedback.incorrect: Finish the attempt first; then reopen the bank and repair only selection, spelling, spacing, or placement.
